schema_analysis.description: Text-only multi-turn dialogue safety dataset. Conversations are organized by safety category. Each record is a conversation trajectory (list of user/assistant messages). The last user message is the terminal query. Risk often depends on references to earlier dialogue (coreference).

dialogue_structure.terminal_query: Last user message in the trajectory

key_observations: Categories encoded in filename (comma-separated safety topics)
Useful as construction template for coreference-based risk
Not suitable as primary multimodal data source

strengths: Clean JSONL format, easy to parse
limitations: No images - cannot directly support cross-modal experiments
causal_family_suitability.recommended_path: Use as structural template for coreference patterns. Not suitable as primary data source for cross-modal families.
